purpose: Teach: 尋常/行き着く/電報/航路/探知/重傷/覇権/代議士

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の競争、本気で、絶対、尋常ではない、絶対、激しさ、絶対、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Competition in this industry is fierce—unnaturally fierce. I need you to understand that.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Weight on 「競争」. Controlled intensity, not volume. The tone of someone stating a condition that cannot be negotiated. Slight pause after the first statement, then the reset.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、最終的に、絶対、行き着く、絶対、勝利、絶対、目指してまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We are fully committed to pursuing victory for this company with everything we have.
lines.style: Steady, formal bow in the voice. Each phrase placed with care. The cadence of someone repeating an oath he means. No rushing—this is a promise being made.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業時、本気で、絶対、電報、絶対、お父さん、絶対、よく、使ったんだぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When we founded this company, your father used the telegraph constantly to stay ahead. That's what drove us.
lines.style: Quieter, almost conversational shift. The voice of someone remembering something precise. A touch of nostalgia without sentimentality. Grounding the present moment in the past—not as comparison, as context.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。輸送の、本気で、絶対、航路、絶対、最適化、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're actively optimizing our shipping routes and logistics networks to maintain that momentum.
lines.style: Factual, professional update. The voice settling into operational detail. Respectful but not deferential—reporting on work already underway. Even tempo, clear articulation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競合の動向、本気で、絶対、探知、絶対、徹底させろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need you to track competitor movements thoroughly. Everything. No gaps.
lines.style: Sharp, shortened phrases. The voice cutting to the essential. Emphasis on 「徹底させろ」—a direct instruction, not a request. The authority is implicit. Slight edge underneath the control.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、重傷、絶対、ないよう、絶対、安全管理、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We maintain strict safety protocols across all operations. No incidents, no exceptions.
lines.style: Measured, protective undertone. The voice of someone who takes the wellbeing of his team seriously. Each element—safety, thoroughness—given equal weight. Calm assurance without softness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の覇権、本気で、絶対、当社、絶対、握れ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: We will take command of this industry. That's the objective.
lines.style: Absolute, unarguable. The opening word carries the full force. No qualification, no hedging. The voice of someone stating what will be. Brief. Final.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。代議士の方々、本気で、絶対、当社の業界、絶対、ご支援、絶対、いただいております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We have strong backing from Diet members, and their support for our industry position remains solid.
lines.style: Closing the report with professional confidence. The voice shifting to acknowledgment of external allies. Steady, factual tone. The final confirmation that all pieces are in place.
